identity.statusNote: Old material.angular.io now redirects to material.angular.dev.

keyLimits.en: MIT-licensed, free to use with no paid tier.

capabilities.en: Provides a full set of Material Design UI components (buttons, forms, navigation, layout, data table) for Angular applications.
Ships alongside the Angular CDK, a set of behavior primitives (overlay, drag-drop, a11y) for building custom components.
Officially maintained by the Angular team at Google, following the same support and release policy as the Angular framework.

limitations.en: Angular-only: no React, Vue or vanilla JS support, so it cannot be reused outside an Angular codebase.
Visual customization beyond Material Design theming requires overriding CSS/SCSS, which adds friction compared to headless component kits.

reason.en: Same Material Design system, but for React instead of Angular.
Utility-first alternative for teams that want full visual control instead of Material Design defaults.
Headless component primitives, an alternative approach for teams not wanting Material Design's visual language.

unknowns: No pricing page relevant, project is fully open source (MIT); exact npm download stats and release cadence not captured.
